name: moddeck
description: A side bar with a live Session box, a Side Question panel (/btw), every mod in grouped cards (a switch is the mod's name, green on and red off; click it to flip), the skills and saved prompts, and an update check.

autoOpen.title: Open automatically
autoOpen.description: Open the side bar at session start where the screen can dock it beside the chat (fullscreen terminal, desktop app). Never reopens it after you close it; /moddeck toggles it.

skillRows.title: Skills shown at once
skillRows.description: How many skills (and saved prompts) the side bar shows at once, at least 5; starred items always fit. A longer list gets a scroll bar (click its track, or use the mouse wheel over the list).

appTheme.title: Side bar colours in the desktop app
appTheme.description: light or dark: match the app's own theme (a mod cannot see it). /moddeck theme light|dark changes and keeps it.

showSession.title: Show the Session box
showSession.description: The live Session box at the top of the side bar: model, context, usage, cost, cache, git, tokens, activity and environment, each row hidden when the engine gives no figure for it.

sessionLayout.title: Session box layout
sessionLayout.description: expanded (one row per line) or compact (rows joined with │ on as few lines as fit). /moddeck rows compact|expanded changes and keeps it.

sessionRows.title: Session box rows
sessionRows.description: Comma list of row ids in display order; an id left out is hidden. /moddeck rows hide|show <id> changes and keeps it.

usageSevenDayAt.title: Show the 7-day window from (%)
usageSevenDayAt.description: The 7-day usage bar shows only once the window is this much used.

toolsMaxVisible.title: Tool calls shown
toolsMaxVisible.description: How many recent tool-call groups the activity row shows.

pushWarn.title: Unpushed commits warning
pushWarn.description: The git row's ahead count turns to the warning colour from this many unpushed commits.

envThreshold.title: Environment row from (count)
envThreshold.description: The environment row shows only when its counts add up to at least this many; 0 = always.

updateCheck.title: Check for updates
updateCheck.description: Every time the side bar is turned on (session start, or opened again), look up the newest release with `git ls-remote --tags` (at most every 6 hours) and, if there is one, ask whether to update. Nothing is installed without your yes. Off: no look-up.

btwMaxChars.title: Longest Side Question answer (characters)
btwMaxChars.description: A longer answer is cut and says so.
